$comment: French/English display overlay DECISION-0070 for calc.allocation. Not compiled into CLIR. Working labels stay ru.

Allocation.text: allocation: one sum, one set of recipients, one policy

AllocationRemainder.text: the allocation remainder is the total minus the allocated amount

AllocationSettled.text: allocation is settled: a share is derived for each recipient

AllocationWellformed.text: the input is fit for allocation: there are recipients and no defect is derived

AllocationZero.text: the zero of the allocation currency is the total minus itself

ClaimForeignToProportionalDefect.text: in proportional allocation a claim is given to the recipient — an input of another mode

ClaimMissingDefect.text: in sequential allocation the recipient's claim is not declared

ClaimNotPositiveDefect.text: the claim must be positive: a zero claim is not a claim

ClaimNotRepresentableDefect.text: the claim has digits below the declared precision

ClassClaims.text: the class claims sum is the total of the claims of recipients of that rank

ClassFloorSum.text: sum of the truncated shares of the class

ClassLeftover.text: the class rounding leftover is its pool minus the sum of truncated shares

ClassPriorClaimsNone.text: before the first class in order there are no claims

ClassPriorClaimsSum.text: before the class stand the claims of all classes of lesser rank

ClassWeightSum.text: the class weight sum is the total of its recipients' weights

DeclaredByMode.text: an allocation with a declared mode is subject to check

DeclaredByPolicy.text: an allocation with a declared remainder policy is subject to check

DeclaredByPrecision.text: an allocation with a declared precision is subject to check

DeclaredByRecipient.text: an allocation that has a recipient is subject to check

DeclaredByTotal.text: an allocation with a declared total is subject to check

DeclaredByUnit.text: an allocation with a declared unit is subject to check

ModeAmbiguousDefect.text: an allocation with two modes is inapplicable

ModeMissingDefect.text: an allocation without a declared mode is inapplicable

NoRecipientsDefect.text: an allocation without a single recipient is inapplicable

PrecisionAmbiguousDefect.text: an allocation with two precisions is inapplicable

PrecisionMissingDefect.text: an allocation without a declared precision is inapplicable: rounding is not implied

PrecisionNegativeDefect.text: a negative precision is not defined

PriorityDuplicateDefect.text: two recipients of the same allocation carry the same priority

ProportionalPool.text: in proportional allocation the single class receives the whole sum

ProportionalWeight.text: in proportional allocation the recipient's weight in the class is the declared weight

RankForeignToProportionalDefect.text: in proportional allocation a class rank is given to the recipient — an input of another mode

RankMissingDefect.text: in sequential allocation the recipient's rank is not declared

Recipient.text: recipient: a position in the allocation

RecipientShortfall.text: the shortfall on the claim is the claim minus the share

RemainderPolicyAmbiguousDefect.text: an allocation with two remainder policies is inapplicable

RemainderPolicyMissingDefect.text: an allocation without a declared remainder policy is inapplicable

SequentialPool.text: the class pool is the lesser of its claims and what remains after previous classes

SequentialWeight.text: in sequential allocation the recipient's weight is the claim in minimal units

ShareFloor.text: the truncated share is the class pool times the weight divided by the weight sum, truncated down to precision

ShareRankWithPriority.text: recipient rank with priority: those with a larger leftover plus those with an equal leftover and a lesser priority

ShareRankWithoutPriority.text: recipient rank without priority: only those with a larger leftover

ShareScaledRemainder.text: discarded fractional part of the share, multiplied by the class weight sum

ShareTieSize.text: number of class recipients with the same leftover and the same rank, including the recipient

ShareWithUnit.text: in largest-remainder distribution, a recipient whose whole group fits before the cutoff receives the truncated share plus one unit

ShareWithheld.text: when the remainder is withheld, the recipient's share is the truncated share

ShareWithoutUnit.text: in largest-remainder distribution, a recipient whose rank is at or beyond the cutoff receives the truncated share

TotalAmbiguousDefect.text: an allocation with two totals is inapplicable

TotalMissingDefect.text: an allocation without a declared total is inapplicable

TotalNegativeDefect.text: a negative total is not allocated

TotalNotRepresentableDefect.text: the total has digits below the declared precision

UnitAmbiguousDefect.text: an allocation with two minimal units is inapplicable

UnitCoarserThanPrecisionDefect.text: the minimal unit has digits below the declared precision

UnitMissingDefect.text: an allocation without a declared minimal unit is inapplicable

UnitNotPositiveDefect.text: the minimal unit must be positive

UnitNotSmallestDefect.text: the minimal unit is coarser than one step of the declared precision

UnresolvedTie.text: the distribution cutoff falls inside a group of equal leftovers not separated by priority

WeightForeignToSequentialDefect.text: in sequential allocation a weight is given to the recipient — an input of another mode

WeightMissingDefect.text: in proportional allocation the recipient's weight is not declared

WeightNotPositiveDefect.text: the recipient's weight must be positive: a zero weight is not participation

allocation_declared.text: the allocation is mentioned by at least one input and is therefore subject to check

allocation_defect.text: defect of the allocation as a whole

allocation_precision.text: share precision: number of digits after the decimal separator

allocation_settled.text: allocation is settled: a share is derived for each recipient

allocation_unit.text: minimal monetary unit of the allocation

allocation_unresolved_tie.text: the remainder distribution cutoff falls on equal leftovers not separated by priority

allocation_wellformed.text: the input is fit for allocation: there are recipients and no defects

class_floor_sum.text: sum of the truncated shares of the class

class_leftover.text: class rounding leftover: pool minus the sum of truncated shares

class_pool.text: class pool: how much it receives to allocate

class_prior_claims.text: sum of the claims of all classes preceding this one

recipient_claim.text: recipient's claim: upper bound of their share

recipient_of.text: the recipient belongs to the allocation

recipient_priority.text: recipient priority on equal leftovers: a smaller number comes first

recipient_rank.text: recipient's class rank; equal ranks are one class

recipient_shortfall.text: shortfall on the claim: claim minus share

share_amount.text: recipient's share after applying the remainder policy

share_floor.text: truncated share: the exact share truncated down to precision

share_rank.text: recipient rank on the leftover: number of class recipients who come before them

share_scaled_remainder.text: discarded fractional part of the share, multiplied by the class weight sum

share_tie_size.text: number of class recipients with the same leftover and the same rank, including the recipient
